payload.text: **One dev/opt/brew contract for Molt, Utilz, Intent and devbin** (hv, 24 Oct, by TUI). (B) your links first: formulas link into brew's bin as normal; Molt-matts puts ~/.local/bin ahead of brew's bin on every sleeve; <tool> use dev|opt|brew switches the per-user link set in ~/.local/bin (no link means brew); doctor names a shadow, comparing resolved dirs. The one contract text lives in Devbin's docs, drafted by devbin-vc, agreed SAME by molt-vc, utilz-vc and intent-vc before anything lands. Molt consequences: revert D6's links-nothing, MOLT_LOCAL_BIN moves to ~/.local/bin (kovacs has them as different dirs), and the zshrc PATH order change.
